description: Counterfactual Replay: re-evaluate a historical Call against alternate models and receive counterfactual cost and Quality Score per candidate, version-stamped. Use to validate a Routing Decision, evaluate a candidate model before promoting it, or build a cost-regression test in CI. Replay output is private to the requesting customer and is not for redistribution. Pricing matches routed Calls (15% of the absolute price difference per Replay, free until $500/month of cumulative routing value). Recommended: set SERACADE_API_KEY env var instead of passing api_key inline.

api_key.description: Your provider API key. Prefer setting SERACADE_API_KEY environment variable instead of passing inline.

call_id.description: The Call to replay. The full log key, as returned by /chat/completions response metadata.

candidate_models.description: Up to 16 candidate models to evaluate against the historical Call.

name: seracade_replay
